title: Holding on meets farewell after failure
meaning: Action around a disrupted unstable foundation from strong attachment can emotionally coexist with farewell to an earlier phase of shared experience.
text: The Tower in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions around an exposed unstable foundation that sharply disrupts an earlier arrangement. The Devil in energy gives a motive to retain compelling participation in which desire restricts freedom to decline. Death in emotions adds the experience of a familiar phase ending. Practice may change sharply to preserve a connection to the familiar while emotionally you already say goodbye to its earlier form. This predicts no relationship ending and proves no need to restore the lost form at any cost.

For example, unconfirmed access to a workshop makes you abandon preparations for a shared season. Declining participation is difficult, so you persistently seek another way to continue. Yet packed tools bring sadness: the familiar evenings in this particular place have ended. **We hold onto participation and already say goodbye to the phase it meant before.** The emotional ending concerns a particular experience; it cancels neither real attachment nor the possibility of another shared undertaking.

Holding on intensifies if farewell becomes proof that the former pattern must be restored immediately. New actions reproduce constraint instead of free choice. Death sets no identical timetable for feelings, and the Devil means more than affection for an activity. The Tower promises no beneficial renewal and appoints no culprit. Different readiness to release a form can remain beside actual revision, requiring words rather than a prepared verdict for both people.
